lines.text: Before I conquered anything, I was drowning in debt.
My creditors wouldn't even let me leave Rome.
So I conquered Gaul to pay it off. You don't have a Gaul.
Your credit card charges over twenty percent a year.
Paying it off is like a guaranteed twenty percent return.
And you're investing while that debt eats you alive? You fucking idiot.
Kill the highest interest debt first. Then invest.
